stumbles.why: Doesn't say what black film is. I would have to know the thin-film term (the thinnest film that appears black just before popping) to follow it.

point: A WebGPU compute-shader soap film demo that you can tilt on a phone: thick film sinks, thin film rises, the edge drains, and it pops. Its colours come from an interference lookup table checked against a reference, but it has only been tested headless.
